Downloads + setup ↗

Morning Briefing stock and weather runs without it.

Desk Buddy Companion App
  • First upload advanced/display firmwareThis adds the calendar/Spotify receiver and MENU hold-to-pair behavior. The basic starter does not include it.
  • Then open the app and connectUse USB, or hold MENU for 2 seconds to pair over Bluetooth.
  • Choose your calendar and musicApprove calendar access and sign in to Spotify. Keep your laptop nearby and awake for updates.

Mac Apple Silicon and Windows x64 pilot downloads available. Physical hardware validation pending.

with Codex

Make your desk buddy feel like yours.

  • Customize layouts, fonts and artwork.
  • Switch between saved Wi-Fi networks automatically.
  • Reprogram buttons for your own actions.
  • Create a pixel pet that shows Codex status.

Your screen. Your style. Your ideas.

Try asking Codex“Give my desk buddy a new look. Design a pixel pet that shows when Codex is working, needs my input, or has finished. Give each status its own expression and a distinctive typeface. Help it choose between my saved home and office Wi-Fi networks.”
